text: At the Brisco County administrative annex on Tuesday, auditors said they found library equipment missing from the county inventory, including two microfilm readers, a barcode scanner and several rolling book carts. County auditor Lila Norren told the Gazette she reviewed the records herself and compared them with what was on hand at the Bayside branch and the smaller East Marsh reading room. “The paperwork showed the items were bought, but they weren’t there,” Norren said. She estimated the missing equipment at about $8,400. Library director Tom Vale said staff first noticed gaps in late October after a shelving move. County officials said they have opened an internal review and are asking anyone with information to come forward.
